events.note: User approved C-008-D1 and C-008-B1: update the design without merge, then run full diagnostic-only soft posterior, covariance, and convergence evidence; B2/B3 remain unapproved.

The first full C-008-B1 run failed closed during canonical JSON serialization because covariance-invalid fits exposed non-finite monitor history. No report, model, READY artifact, database write, or runtime change occurred. The repair preserves the fact as null plus history_non_finite_count and adds a distinguishing test.

It selected no seed, applied no formal threshold, preserved hard semantic authority, and wrote no model or READY artifact. Evidence does not support B2; B3 remains a recommendation pending user decision.

User approved C-008-B3-STRUCTURAL-A and C-008-B3-DIAG-02: D3-01-A, D3-02-B, D5-02-B only in the same fixed numerical environment, and D7-01-A. D3-03 is approved only for explicit full parameters and manual initialization, not proposed numeric values. DIAG-02 may run seeds 42-49 for both 31-sector families without seed selection, model or READY writes, hard-semantic changes, database writes, or runtime actions. D4, D5-01, and D6 exact contracts remain pending, and every PR merge requires separate user approval.
